name: Kenzaki Atsushi
source:
A tutor hired by Ryouta’s parents for this summer to help him pass the entrance exam for college. He is attending the university Ryouta is aiming for.

He has more than enough experience as a tutor and is a fresh sportsman who is good at both studying and exercising.
